{{Top|leg}}
[[Curich Engineering]]'s '''Maneuvering Fin''' was a rear wing and stabilizer conversion kit for [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering's]] [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]]. It was such a common modification to the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that many people thought it was part of the original design. By [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the Maneuvering Fin cost 5,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase.
